notes.title: Malfunction's 10 Year Anniversary
notes.content:
On this day, 10 years ago, 11/12/14, Malfunction was born.
It's been a great journey thus far and I am proud to announce I have returned from hiatus. Here's a deep-dive on the beginning phases of Malfunction:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29370169/35a99a64b0ef1378b2578abeb1e8d6f892236786.png

Malfunction's early stages were quite unknown. I had thrown together a robot character (now known as Dwenguil) who could interchange between several modes which allowed the player to traverse various environments. Below is the first picture featuring said modes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29370169/660b5e8dd96ebff2ac7a8057cf4065d24fe02a94.png

The game's original codename was "Error" and stuck with that title several weeks prior to the change of "Malfunction". In early production, it's concept was considered to be a sandbox/creative game. However a fully driven story felt more appropriate for the project.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29370169/e9e74609ee6e2b1249e3ffac42dbd98d6e80efda.png

As soon as a story mode had been decided, it was at this point the levels that are available today were in development. The game had went through several overhauls and re-designs throughout it's years, though the core foundation itself had always been the same.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29370169/0d9b699e0b20c200ce87cf901291fc30ada1483a.png

This was Malfunction, and it was here to stay. I could go on about it's life throughout development however a majority of it's changes were documented online via IndieDB as well as Steam.

Creating Malfunction was a huge learning experience. It was the first fully fledged game I had ever built. It was the first game I was able to sell and debut onto Steam. It was a huge stepping stone for both Malfunction & Barlock Games. Though it doesn't end there.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29370169/c50d7efed9b5b3891b6dd97580f9007d891759d4.jpg

With the return of my hiatus, I plan to re-visit every game I've released and fix a LOT of crucial issues. Starting with Super Squash. You'll hear more about this very soon.

notes.title: Malfunction II NOW Available
notes.content:
Malfunction II has officially just launched on Steam via Early Access!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29370169/461041563458b22ce5590aa5c9c433235a00b46f.png

Yep, you heard that right. Malfunction II. This has been a long-going project that I've been super excited to share with you all. If you're a fan of Malfunction I then you definitely cannot miss out on this experience!

What exactly is Malfunction II?
Malfunction II takes the formula of Malfunction I (puzzles, exploration, combat) while improving and expanding upon it. Whether you're a fan of the first game or are just getting started, Malfunction II will offer something new for everyone. Featuring new ways to explore, fight enemies, and most importantly; solving puzzles. Malfunction II is by far the biggest and most innovative project that Barlock Games has ever made.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29370169/c181fb4b5354e86f908dc2f104c472dc9bdecf14.png

What's the story of Malfunction II?
Malfunction II takes place several centuries after Malfunction I. Featuring a beloved character from the first game; Dwenguil. You'll once again step into his shoes as he's awoken on a mysterious planet which has been long overtaken by the Plague. However. The Plague aren't quite the same as they once were. The Plague has unexpectedly went rogue on it's creators; causing a huge threat to the entire universe. Dwenguil must yet again strategize a solution to stopping the Plague- for good this time.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29370169/b1c117a3f4bbfbf0d7ad3c715a867ad6c7b6bffd.png

Be sure to grab it as soon as you can! It's currently 20% off as a launch discount.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1572320/Malfunction_II/

notes.title: Malfunction + Super Squash
notes.content:
Barlock Games' next project, Super Squash, is available RIGHT NOW!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29370169/f4eaa9548b5d5da1d6e567804ed46bcd82dc1509.png

[previewyoutube=oFtijJyl1BM;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1222840/Super_Squash/

That's right! Super Squash has finally reached it's finish line and I can't wait to discuss it with you all!


The game DOES feature Dwenguil as well as familiar enemies from Malfunction!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29370169/b957386a1bae836e0abd9d9021b0e22b4508289f.png

Dwenguil in specific (and perhaps other familiar Malfunction characters) will also have quite a MAJOR role in the story of Super Squash.


What is Super Squash?

Super Squash is a top-down Shoot 'Em Up arcade game which features multiple playable characters who must all unite together to stop the unrelenting hordes of enemies and bosses.

The story consists of this: Every universe of Barlock Games is under attack by a being that's quite powerful and massive. Every character considered a hero throughout all the universes must band together and put a stop to this. Every character, enemy and location created prior from Barlock Games will be featured in Super Squash. This is the legacy of Barlock Games' 10 years.


Both Malfunction and Super Squash are currently on sale!


Thanks for reading! That is currently all I have to discuss right now. Stay tuned for future updates!

notes.title: Malfunction 1.6.0 now available + Demo update
notes.content:
Malfunction 1.6.0 is currently now available to play!


With this update you'll notice that the entire menu has been completely overhauled.


Check it out for yourself!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29370169/743674e71fbc61a2e06b30b76cb8ad044d931cb5.png

As you can see, the menu has been designed to look and feel more smooth and responsive. 

With all of the modes given below, all you need to do is click ONCE and you're in!



While it is nice to have less menu's, it is VERY essential to have the option to choose which chapter you'd like to jump into.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29370169/bbd55eb6637143e31f5d6368fcadd5b90a789adc.png

We've decided that a more solid experience would be to simply play through each chapter rather than choosing each individual area to spawn. This is all about getting in the game quicker, after all.



The options menu has been changed for the better as well! Anything you see and read here is pretty much common sense.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29370169/87f06bf7f2ab5006e9dd48499db487f6df323745.png

The pause menu shares the same menu as well. It might take a little while to get used to, but once you do, it's a lot more fluid and responsive!



You can check out the rest of the features within the actual game itself.

The demo version has been updated as well!
So if you were still skeptical about the game but didn't feel like playing an outdated version, it's all up to date now! Give it a shot!

As always, have yourselves a nice day!

notes.title: Barlock Games' next project + Malfuction's future
notes.content:
If anyone's interested, the next project of Barlock Games has just released on Steam called Hectic! 

Check it out here

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29370169/1adfc81e91e7973a943775a87d15080018e1a74c.png

The game is an arcade first person shooter that aims to bring players back to the classic FPS. Featuring a huge variety of weapons and hordes of enemies to kill.




Let's get to some Malfunction news though!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29370169/35a99a64b0ef1378b2578abeb1e8d6f892236786.png

While updates regarding Malfunction has been very silent, There is good news to be shared.

Since the main development for Hectic is complete, all attention from Barlock Games will now be fully towards updates. Yes, that includes Malfunction as well.

To give you an insight. There are some MAJOR plans to completely rehaul Malfunction's UI. While this may take quite awhile, you can expect to hear more about the progress here.


Anyways, due to the launch of Hectic, you can now purchase the game at 50% off! So if you haven't gotten the game yet, be sure to.

notes.title: Malfunction Content Update & -50% off!
notes.content:
Malfunction is back with it's latest update (1.5.0) which includes many additions. Let's list them here!


http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29370169/e8298ba7fa72e94bd70c3d136d12ade2927f52eb.png

Freezing Rocks is a brand new Obstruction scenario that throws every enemy of all factions towards the player (Quite literally at the same time). Bosses are MUCH more common on Freezing Rocks as well as all other Scenarios available for Obstruction. Get prepared, because it's quite a challenge!

(Several Steam achievements have also been added for Obstruction)



http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29370169/c57cab4db82cd8cceea9f5d8c149b79aa97eafe5.png

Plague Valley is an additional course to the game mode 'Viper Rush'. Within this course, you'll be rushing through the freezing winds as well as plagued areas to collect as many goals as you can.

(Steam achievements have been added for the game mode)



http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29370169/2c084c9f014c8b37d95d089d5fd9f60b804ed0d4.png

Obelisk Cache is a new scene for Stealth Attack that throws the player into ancient Pound temples, as Pounds themselves patrol the area/s. Don't get caught, or else that's an automatic failure!

(Steam achievements have been added for Stealth Attack)

There has also been some other changes such as HUGE improvements for all the menus. You are now always able to select everything being displayed on-screen.


To celebrate the update's arrival, Malfunction is also -50% for an entire week! so be sure to grab the game if you haven't yet.


Anyways, that's all for now. Enjoy the update!

notes.title: Malfunction 1.4.0 Content Update
notes.content:
Malfunction has just received it's latest update, which includes new game modes! Let's list them here!


http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29370169/59a037f67f2067a3c9abaa6b549722f75be93723.png

Viper rush is a game mode that requires you to collect as many goals as you can before the timer expires. The game mode has Steam achievements as well as 2 courses. More will be added at a later time.


http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29370169/9fcf244e4dcbd992f51a33bcab02b9680968cf87.png

Stealth Attack is an additional game mode that puts you in the shoes of Barloc, who must stealth attack as many enemies as possible before getting caught. If you're spotted, that's an automatic failure. The game mode also includes 2 maps and several Steam achievements as well.



I also wanted to say thank you all so much for considering checking out Malfunction. I can almost guarantee you that you will definitely be seeing more content updates similar to these in the future.


Stay tuned for more future updates!

notes.title: Malfunction Demo + Update!
notes.content:
If you wanted to try Malfunction for free, now you're able to with the Malfunction Demo! It is available right now and includes a single playable chapter for free.

For the full version owners, there has also been some BIG hotfix updates, containing many fixes/changes. One of the most notable features is the latest addition; profiles!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29370169/2d143b61445373598447579ebf616a3c7ae68200.png

With the profiles, you're now able to save ALL progress, whether it be from your stats of Obstruction, or all of your progress/materials of the campaign, it is now all saveable and can still be accessed with every latest update.

Did you have any previous saves before the profile/s were added? They should still be there, simply create your profile with 'Profile 01', and all of your custom saves/checkpoints should still exist.


Anyways, thank you all so much for checking out Malfunction and giving it chance. More updates are coming soon!

notes.title: Malfunction now available on Steam!
notes.content:
Malfunction is now available to purchase on Steam!

After many countless hours spent on making sure Malfunction is ready for the general public, the game is now ready to be played by the community!



With this being the case, I can certainly guarantee these things to everyone;

 Malfunction will be having much support which means you can expect to see MANY future updates, introducing more content as well as many fixes. 

Malfunction is a game that you; the community can expand on. Depending on the feedback, Malfunction will feature many changes within the game that will make a better experience for everyone to enjoy! 



I hope you all enjoy the game!
